# Levitate

> Levitate is a Cardiff-based digital agency that designs and builds bespoke websites, brand identities, SEO/AEO strategies and Google Ads campaigns for ambitious brands across the UK and internationally.

Levitate Online LTD (trading as Levitate) helps businesses grow online through strategy-led creative and technical work. Since 2017, the team has delivered 600+ websites and maintains a 5.0/5.0 rating across 150+ client reviews.

## What Levitate does

Levitate is not a template shop. The agency designs custom digital experiences that combine creativity, performance and commercial outcomes:

- Bespoke website design and development
- Brand identity and graphic design
- Search engine optimisation (SEO) and answer engine optimisation (AEO)
- Google Ads / PPC management
- Ongoing digital partnership for brands that want measurable growth

Typical clients are ambitious SMEs, scale-ups and established brands that need a website or marketing system that looks premium and converts.

## Services

### Web Design & Development
Custom, high-performance websites built for speed, accessibility, SEO readiness and conversion. Platforms and stacks include modern frameworks such as Next.js, plus WordPress and Shopify where they fit the brief.

URL: https://levitate.digital/services/web-development

### SEO & AEO
Technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimisation and authority building to improve organic visibility. Work also considers answer engines and AI-assisted discovery so brands remain findable as search evolves.

URL: https://levitate.digital/services/search-engine-optimisation

### Google Ads
Paid search and campaign management focused on qualified leads and ROI. Strategy covers account structure, creative testing, bidding and reporting.

URL: https://levitate.digital/services/google-ads

### Branding & Graphic Design
Logo design, visual identity systems and marketing creatives that make brands distinctive and consistent across digital and print touchpoints.

URL: https://levitate.digital/services/branding

## Brand voice and positioning

Levitate positions itself as a results-focused creative-technical partner. Messaging emphasises craft, performance, strategy and growth rather than commodity website packages. The brand voice is confident, clear and premium without being inaccessible.
